Elements.Script: Value:AddToggle('MagicPower', {Title = 'Magic Power', Default = false, Callback = function(V) getgenv().MagicPower = V; if V then task.spawn(function() while getgenv().MagicPower do pcall(function() game:GetService('ReplicatedStorage').Remotes.GainMagicPower:FireServer() end); task.wait(0.1) end end) end end})

Value:AddToggle('KillMobs', {Title = 'Kill Mobs', Default = false, Callback = function(V) getgenv().KillMobs = V; if V then task.spawn(function() while getgenv().KillMobs do pcall(function() local dmg = game:GetService('Players').LocalPlayer:GetAttribute('MagicPower') or 1; local folder = workspace:FindFirstChild('DungeonMobs'); if folder then for _, child in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do game:GetService('ReplicatedStorage').Remotes.DealMobDamage:FireServer(child, dmg) end end end); task.wait(0.5) end end) end end})
